description: A utility class for testing database upgrades within the OpenMRS project. It manages setting up an H2 in-memory database, loading datasets, executing Liquibase migrations, and handling database connections and cleanup.

classes.name: DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil
classes.description: Provides methods to set up an in-memory H2 database, load datasets, perform schema upgrades via Liquibase, and manage database connections for testing purposes.

methods.name: DatabaseUpgradeTestUtil
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test database from a specified resource path, sets up connections and configurations.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all database connections and deletes temporary files and directories.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the active JDBC Connection object.

methods.name: executeDataset
methods.description: Loads test data into the database from a specified dataset XML resource.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Performs a SELECT query on the database with optional WHERE clause and specified columns, returning the results as a list of maps.

methods.name: insertGlobalProperty
methods.description: Inserts a global property key-value pair into the database.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs a database schema upgrade using a default Liquibase changelog.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs a database schema upgrade using a specified Liquibase changelog filename.
